integrity: The recurrence follows from a complete local clique case split for selected and omitted parent vertices and inductive independence across the block-incidence forest. Its arithmetic circuit gives the exact sum of monomials for all valid sets. Direct neighborhood-based subset enumeration agrees through order six and on larger clique-glued instances, including independent numerical multivariate specializations.
scientific_limitations: Applies to finite simple block graphs, including disconnected graphs, not arbitrary chordal or split graphs.
General bounded-clique-width counting theory already implies qualitative polynomial-time countability on block graphs; no novelty is claimed for tractability alone.
The output is a compact multivariate arithmetic circuit; expanding every multivariate monomial can take exponential space.
Algorithmic counts are arithmetic operations, with large-integer bit complexity separate.
Full text of the 2012 P3-Caratheodory-number paper was unavailable; only its abstract-level stated scope could be compared.
title: A three-state multivariate \(P_3\)-convexity polynomial for block graphs
